brief.prompt_action: The complete image is ONLY an EMPTY material swatch: Warm grey and muted ochre small gravel, even stochastic stone distribution with no large clusters. Seamless full-bleed surface, pattern continues across all four edges, even lighting. Fill the entire square edge-to-edge with this anonymous ground texture. No vehicle, car, buggy, wheels, object, icon, border, frame, grid or scene anywhere. The deliverable is a flat surface material, not a racing scene. Show a SINGLE unrepeated tile, NOT a 2x2 demonstration, NOT repeated quadrants, NOT mirrored halves. Every part of the image has different small stochastic grain; no patch of the image is copied elsewhere inside the square. Very low contrast fine particles, no outlines around large stones, no large stains or cracks.
